description_and_note: DRAGEN DNA alignment failed for run 250304_NB551234_0098_AH7K2BGXM, sample CGP-0011: insufficient disk space on /scratch (0 bytes free). Resolution: purged orphaned DRAGEN map/sort intermediates and extended /scratch LVM volume by 2 TB; restarted failed stage, run completed successfully. Added Nagios alert at 85% /scratch utilization.

Nirvana annotation crashed with java.lang.OutOfMemoryError - Java heap space exceeded at 16GB, sample CGP-0019. Resolution: increased annotation JVM -Xmx from 16GB to 32GB in pipeline config and requeued the quarantined sample; annotation completed on retry. Documented heap sizing for large variant sets.

DRAGEN BCL Convert failed for run 250311_M02158_0204_000000000-ABCDE: RunInfo.xml not found, run folder may be incomplete. Root cause: copyComplete.txt written before sequencer finished transfer to NFS. Resolution: lab re-staged the run folder, confirmed RunInfo.xml and RTAComplete.txt present, reran analysis. Watcher updated to also require RTAComplete.txt before launch.

DRAGEN alignment halted for run 250313_A00521_0151_BH9LMDSXY: GRCh38 reference index corrupted, .bwt file checksum mismatch. Resolution: re-staged GRCh38 DRAGEN hash table from internal mirror, verified MD5 checksum, resumed alignment. Scheduled weekly reference integrity verification job.

Compute node compute-07 lost during run 250315_A00521_0152_BHA2LDSXY; 4 sample jobs killed. Root cause: ECC memory failure on the node. Resolution: cordoned and drained compute-07, scheduler requeued jobs on healthy nodes, run finished. Node sent to hardware vendor for DIMM replacement.

Sample CGP-0042 from run 250318_A00521_0153_BHB7LDSXY failed QC: GC content 68% indicates possible bacterial contamination. Resolution: sample flagged and excluded; run continued for remaining libraries. Lab re-extracted from a fresh FFPE curl per TSO 500 Reference Guide (min 2 mm3 tissue) and reprocessed under a new accession.

HayStack MRD ctDNA assay reporting reduced sensitivity at low tumor fraction; background error rate elevated. Resolution: re-baselined the patient-specific panel against the matched germline normal and refreshed the error-suppression model; sensitivity restored within LOD spec.

Outbound result delivery for run 250322_NB551234_0101_AHC3BGXM failed via nginx after 3 attempts (HTTP 502/504/503); task stuck in PENDING_REPORT. Root cause: reporting tool pod OOMKilled. Resolution: increased reporting tool memory limit and restarted deployment; CGP outbound retry queue redelivered the result, report generated (reportId RPT-43110).

Result POST rejected by nginx for run 250325_M02158_0207_000000000-FGHIJ: HTTP 401 Unauthorized, service token expired. Resolution: rotated the CGP service account token in the secrets vault and reloaded the pipeline credential; redelivery succeeded. Added token-expiry alert 7 days ahead.

Result POST failed for run 250327_NB551234_0103_AHD4BGXM: HTTP 404 Not Found via nginx, endpoint /api/v1/results not routed. Root cause: nginx location block dropped during an unrelated config change. Resolution: restored the /api/v1/results location and reloaded nginx; queued result redelivered. Added config validation to CI before nginx reload.

Analysis task aborted for run 250329_M02158_0208_000000000-KLMNO: NFS mount /mnt/seq/runs went stale during read (Stale file handle). Root cause: NFS server failover. Resolution: remounted the share on the CGP host and rescheduled pending runs; analysis completed. Added NFS health probe to the watcher loop.

Hematologic NGS panel demultiplexing produced low %>=Q30 (78%) on run 250401_NB552010_0044_AHE5BGXM. Root cause: under-clustering due to low library loading concentration. Resolution: lab re-pooled and re-loaded at corrected concentration; rerun passed Q30 spec.

High undetermined reads (9.8%) on run 250403_A00521_0160_BHF7LMDSXY exceeding 8% guideline. Root cause: index collision from incorrect UPxx assignment in SampleSheet. Resolution: corrected unique index primer assignments per TSO 500 low-plex diversity guidance and re-demultiplexed; undetermined dropped to 3.6%.

Sample CGP-0007 median exon coverage 412x below 500x guideline (delta Cq 5.4). Root cause: low-quality FFPE DNA input. Resolution: per TSO 500 Reference Guide (delta Cq <=5), lab repeated library prep with increased DNA input; re-sequenced sample met coverage spec.

RNA library DV200 18% below 20% spec for sample CGP-0033-RNA, fusion calling unreliable. Resolution: requested RNA re-extraction; degraded sample rejected per TSO 500 Reference Guide DV200 >=20% criterion and re-prepped from a higher-quality scroll.

Run 250410_NB551234_0108_AHG6BGXM analysis succeeded but remained in PENDING_REPORT; report not visible in UI. Root cause: reporting tool received result (nginx 200) but report-build worker queue stalled. Resolution: restarted the report-build worker; report regenerated for the existing result without resend.

DRAGEN FPGA board 1 went offline mid-run; alignment throughput dropped. Root cause: accelerator driver crash. Resolution: reloaded the DRAGEN FPGA driver and restarted the host agent; both boards back online, run resumed.

Watcher launched analysis for run 250414_M02158_0210_000000000-PQRST before sequencing finished; copyComplete.txt present but RTAComplete.txt absent. Resolution: aborted premature task; instrument completed transfer; reran. Confirmed the RTAComplete.txt guard from INC0042003 is now enforced.

HayStack MRD sample tracking ID mismatch between LIMS accession and panel manifest, risk of wrong-patient baseline. Resolution: corrected the manifest mapping and re-ran reconciliation; added a pre-analysis LIMS/manifest identity check to block mismatches.

SampleSheet parse error for run 250418_A00521_0165_BHH8LDSXY: invalid UMI adapter field. Resolution: corrected SampleSheet to the TSO 500 UMI adapter (UMI1) format for DNA libraries and re-submitted; BCL Convert succeeded.

MSI call reported insufficient usable sites (22/130) for sample CGP-0050, result inconclusive. Root cause: low coverage over microsatellite loci. Resolution: re-sequenced sample to higher depth; MSI re-evaluated as MSI-Stable with 96 usable sites.

TMB eligible region below threshold (0.7 Mb) for sample CGP-0061, TMB suppressed. Root cause: poor coverage uniformity from degraded FFPE. Resolution: repeated enrichment per TSO 500 protocol; eligible region recovered to 1.28 Mb and TMB reported.

Hematologic panel small-variant caller producing false positives in homopolymer regions of CEBPA. Resolution: enabled homopolymer indel filter and updated the block list for known artifact positions; validated against truth set, FP rate within spec.

RNA fusion caller returned zero calls for an entire batch on run 250428_NB551234_0114_AHJ9BGXM despite positive control. Root cause: RNA probe pool (OPR1) not applied during enrichment. Resolution: lab repeated the RNA enrichment with OPR1 per TSO 500 Reference Guide; EML4-ALK control recovered.

CGP could not connect to nginx proxy cgp-proxy.internal:443 (connection refused) for run 250430_M02158_0214_000000000-UVWXY; no entry at proxy. Root cause: nginx restarted during a maintenance window without connection draining. Resolution: added a PreStop drain hook and readiness gating to the nginx deployment; result redelivered from the retry queue.

HRD genomic instability score discordant with orthogonal method for sample CGP-0072. Root cause: low tumor purity. Resolution: flagged result with purity caveat and reissued; documented minimum purity guidance for HRD reporting (HRD option per TSO 500 Reference Guide).

Analysis output differed from validated baseline after a DRAGEN upgrade. Root cause: DRAGEN software version mismatch between nodes. Resolution: pinned all nodes to the validated DRAGEN TSO 500 version (2.5.0) and re-ran concordance check; outputs matched baseline.

HayStack MRD ctDNA input below assay threshold; library yield insufficient. Resolution: requested additional plasma volume and re-extracted cell-free DNA; library passed input QC and MRD analysis completed.

Cluster scheduler backlog delayed multiple CGP runs beyond TAT. Root cause: a stuck job held a large resource reservation. Resolution: killed the stuck job and rebalanced the queue; added a max-runtime watchdog to auto-kill hung stages.

Report PDF generation failed in reporting tool for run 250512_A00521_0172_BHK2LDSXY despite nginx 200 on result delivery. Root cause: malformed combined variant JSON missing a required metrics field. Resolution: patched the metrics serializer in CGP and re-sent the result; report generated.

Index hopping observed on NovaSeq run 250514_A00521_0173_BHL3LDSXY causing cross-sample read assignment. Resolution: switched the affected pool to unique dual indexes and re-sequenced; hopping below threshold.
Hematologic panel coverage dropout in FLT3 ITD region. Root cause: GC-rich amplicon underperformance. Resolution: adjusted probe balance and re-enriched; coverage restored across FLT3.

Annotation flagged outdated ClinVar data source (47 days old) producing stale clinical significance. Resolution: refreshed the Nirvana annotation data bundle (ClinVar, gnomAD) and re-annotated affected runs; added a monthly data-bundle update job.

Duplicate analysis task launched for run 250521_NB551234_0120_AHM4BGXM, two tasks competing for the same output dir. Root cause: watcher fired twice after an NFS reconnect. Resolution: added a per-run lock file; killed the duplicate task and kept the first. Output integrity verified.

Low enrichment yield across a library prep batch feeding run 250523_A00521_0178_BHN5LDSXY (<3 ng/uL post-amp). Root cause: SMB (Streptavidin Magnetic Beads) used past room-temperature equilibration with incomplete resuspension. Resolution: lab repeated enrichment following TSO 500 bead-handling guidance; libraries passed normalization input.

UMI consensus family size abnormally low (1.4) reducing error correction for run 250526_NB551234_0122_AHP6BGXM. Root cause: over-amplification / low molecular complexity from low input. Resolution: re-prepped with increased input per guide; mean family size recovered to 4.1.
HayStack MRD LOD baseline drift detected in QC trending. Resolution: recalibrated the assay baseline using the latest control cohort and revalidated LOD; trending returned to control limits.

Pipeline could not write combined variant output for run 250530_A00521_0181_BHQ7LDSXY: permission denied on /mnt/results. Root cause: results directory ownership changed by a storage migration. Resolution: corrected directory ACLs for the CGP service account and re-ran the metrics stage.

Intermittent nginx upstream timeouts (HTTP 504) on result delivery during peak batch hours. Root cause: reporting tool single replica saturated. Resolution: scaled reporting tool to 3 replicas behind the nginx upstream and increased proxy_read_timeout; 504s cleared.

Enrichment failure traced to incorrect HYB1 thermal cycler program in the prep feeding run 250604_NB551234_0127_AHR8BGXM. Resolution: lab corrected the HYB1 program (95C 10m, stepdown, hold 57C) per TSO 500 Reference Guide and repeated first hybridization; libraries passed.
Adapter-dimer contamination elevated in hematologic libraries reducing usable reads. Resolution: added an extra bead cleanup and re-quantified; adapter content within spec on rerun.

False MSI-High call for sample CGP-0088 not reproduced on orthogonal testing. Root cause: low input inflating instability estimate. Resolution: re-sequenced at adequate input; reclassified MSI-Stable. Added low-input guardrail to MSI reporting.

Reporting tool returned HTTP 500 during report build; nginx logged upstream 500. Root cause: reporting DB connection pool exhausted under concurrent loads. Resolution: increased DB pool size and added connection reaping; backlog of results reprocessed.

GRCh38 reference mirror sync failed leaving a partial hash table; pre-run integrity check blocked launches. Resolution: re-synced the reference bundle from the upstream mirror and verified checksums; queued runs released. Mirror sync now checksum-gated.

Watcher missed a completed run (250616_M02158_0220_000000000-ZABCD) for ~3 hours past copyComplete.txt. Root cause: poll interval too long after a watcher restart. Resolution: reduced poll interval and added a startup catch-up scan; run picked up and analyzed.
